About & Contact

UtilForge is a suite of 40 standalone, zero-latency developer utilities, 292 interactive "X vs. Y" cost & performance calculators, and a 26-item Boilerplate, MCP Server & AI Workflow Marketplace engineered to execute 100% locally inside your browser.

Why We Built UtilForge

Most online converters upload your sensitive JSON payloads, JWT tokens, SQL queries, .env files, or images to remote backend servers—introducing privacy risks, file-size limits, and network latency. UtilForge eliminates the backend entirely by leveraging modern browser engines (WebCrypto, HTML5 Canvas, DOMParser, and TextEncoder).
